text:
```yaml
name: Abuse Detection Cron

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *' # Runs daily at 02:00 UTC

concurrency:
  group: abuse-detection
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  abuse-detection:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run abuse detection
        id: abuse
        run: |
          set -e
          npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts --last 24h --parallel 3 --auto-apply > abuse-output.txt
          echo "result<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          cat abuse-output.txt >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post results to Slack
        uses: tokorom/action-slack-incoming-webhook@d57bf1eb618f3dae9509afefa70d5774ad3d42bf
        with:
          text: |
            Abuse detection cron run completed.
            Results:
            ${{ steps.abuse.outputs.result }}
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
